description.text: Semester: The first semester: from the beginning of September to next late January. The second semester: from the end of February to early July.

duration.text: The Human Resources Management at Tianjin University of Science and Technology is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included . 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK

requirements.text: Senior high school and above; Good health; Non-Chinese speakers must reach a C level (Band 3) in Chinese Proficiency Test for foreigners; Have to take some entrance tests for relevant courses
